How to use this page

Each layer page cites sources as [n], numbered as in its dossier. This page collects all of those lists in one place. Type in the box to filter by publisher, company, title, date or website (for example 10-Q, TrendForce or 2026-08), or pick a layer. The counts update as you type.

An entry tagged not re-fetched is one the analyst cited from prior knowledge of the filing, from a search-results listing or from a headline only, because the research session's web-search budget ran out. Treat numbers that rest only on those entries with more caution; the methodology page explains how the fact-check passes handled them.
